idea-plugin.name: Composite Build Manager
idea-plugin.description:
Composite Build Manager — Visualize and manage Android multi-module Composite Build configurations from a side panel in Android Studio.

Switch between LOCAL (source) and MAVEN (AAR) build modes per module with one click. Changes are written automatically and take effect on the next Gradle build.

Features
  • Module status visualization — Displays LOCAL / MAVEN / MISSING status for all submodules
  • One-click toggle — Check/uncheck to switch includeBuild; state is written automatically
  • Batch operations — Switch all modules to LOCAL or MAVEN with a single click
  • Download missing modules — Auto-clone missing submodules via the "↓ Download" button
  • Gradle Sync — Trigger Gradle sync after config changes; button highlights when there are unsynced changes
  • Branch management — Shows the current Git branch per module; supports one-click switching with uncommitted-change checks
  • Search & filter — Filter modules by name or by LOCAL / MAVEN / CUSTOM status
  • Custom components — Manually add local components with dependency substitution rules; paths are persisted
  • Line markers — Shows markers in build.gradle for dependencies that support composite build; resolves group:artifact from Version Catalog
  • Auto-refresh — Refreshes toggle state when the panel is shown or collapsed/expanded
  • Context menu — Right-click in Project view → Composite Build for quick access
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Improvements
  • Deploys the CBM init script to the Gradle User Home configured for the current Android Studio project
  • Supports gradle.user.home, GRADLE_USER_HOME, and the default ~/.gradle fallback
  • Automatically redeploys the init script when the IDE Gradle User Home setting changes
